Question: How many annual leave days do employees receive?
Answer: Annual leave entitlement varies by country and grade. India: 18 days; USA: 15 days (accrued); UK: 25 days; Germany: 28 days; Singapore: 14–18 days. See the Leave Policy (HR-LP-001) for full country-specific tables.

Question: How do I apply for annual leave?
Answer: Log in to Workday > Time Off > Request Time Off. Select 'Annual Leave' as the type and submit. Your manager will receive an automated approval request. See Leave Policy Section 3.

Question: Who approves my leave request?
Answer: Your direct manager (People Manager) approves all leave requests in Workday. For absences longer than 10 consecutive days, HR Business Partner co-approval is required. See Leave Policy Section 5.2.

Question: Can I carry forward unused annual leave to the next year?
Answer: Yes. USA employees may carry forward up to 5 days. India employees may carry forward up to 15 days. UK employees may carry forward up to 5 days with manager approval. Germany: up to the legal maximum per the Bundesurlaubsgesetz. See Leave Policy Section 8.

Question: What happens to my unused leave when I resign?
Answer: Upon resignation you will receive a payout for accrued but unused annual leave at your base daily rate. The exact calculation is in Leave Policy Section 9 (Leave Encashment). India employees must have completed at least one year of service to be eligible.

Question: How many sick leave days do I get?
Answer: India: 12 days per year. USA: 10 days per year (or as per state law if greater). UK: Covered under SSP after a waiting period; company provides 10 days full pay sick leave annually. Germany: Unlimited per law (Entgeltfortzahlungsgesetz) subject to medical certification after 3 days. Singapore: 14 days outpatient + 60 days hospitalization. See Leave Policy Section 4.

Question: Do I need a doctor's note for sick leave?
Answer: For absences of 1–2 days: self-certification is accepted. For absences of 3 or more consecutive days: a medical certificate from a registered physician is required and must be uploaded to Workday within 2 business days of your return. See Leave Policy Section 4.3.

Question: What is emergency leave?
Answer: Emergency leave is up to 3 days of paid leave granted for unforeseen personal situations such as a natural disaster affecting your home or a serious accident involving an immediate family member. It does not cover bereavement — see bereavement leave for that. See Leave Policy Section 5.

Question: How many days of bereavement leave am I entitled to?
Answer: Immediate family (spouse, child, parent, sibling): 5 days paid. Extended family (grandparent, in-law, aunt/uncle): 3 days paid. Close friend or non-listed relation: 1 day with manager discretion. See Leave Policy Section 6.

Question: What is the maternity leave policy?
Answer: India: 26 weeks (182 days) for first and second child; 12 weeks for third+ child (per Maternity Benefit Act). UK: Up to 52 weeks statutory; OptiAgent provides 16 weeks at full pay. USA: 16 weeks at full pay via company policy. Germany: 14 weeks statutory (Mutterschutzgesetz); OptiAgent tops up to 100% of salary for the full period. Singapore: 16 weeks for Singapore citizen child; 8 weeks for non-citizen. See Leave Policy Section 7.

Question: How do I notify HR about maternity leave?
Answer: Notify your manager and HR Business Partner at least 8 weeks before your planned start date. Submit a formal leave request in Workday with your expected start and return dates. Attach your medical certificate confirming pregnancy and due date. See Leave Policy Section 7.4.

Question: What is the paternity leave policy?
Answer: India: 5 days paid. UK: Up to 2 weeks statutory; OptiAgent provides 4 weeks at full pay. USA: 4 weeks at full pay. Germany: No statutory paternity leave; OptiAgent provides 2 weeks at full pay. Singapore: 2 weeks paid (government-paid for Singapore citizen child). See Leave Policy Section 7.5.

Question: Is adoption leave available?
Answer: Yes. The primary caregiver receives the same entitlement as maternity leave in each country. Secondary caregivers receive the same entitlement as paternity leave. See Leave Policy Section 7.6.

Question: Can I take study leave?
Answer: Yes. Full-time courses leading to a recognized qualification relevant to your role: up to 5 days paid study leave per exam/assessment event. Part-time study assistance is at manager discretion. See Leave Policy Section 10.

Question: What is compensatory off (Comp Off)?
Answer: If you are required to work on a declared company holiday or a weekend specifically requested by your manager with prior HR approval you are entitled to a compensatory day off to be taken within 60 days. See Leave Policy Section 11.

Question: Can I work remotely from another country?
Answer: Remote work from a country other than your country of employment requires advance approval from your manager, HR Business Partner, and Legal (for tax and immigration compliance). Approval is not guaranteed and must be obtained at least 3 weeks in advance. See Employee Handbook Section 9.3 for the remote work policy.

Question: What is the hybrid work policy at OptiAgent?
Answer: OptiAgent operates a hybrid work model. Most roles require 3 days per week in the office (Tuesday through Thursday are company anchor days). Engineering roles may require up to 4 days depending on team needs. Full remote roles are designated at hiring and specified in your offer letter. See Employee Handbook Section 9.2.

Question: Can I permanently work fully remote?
Answer: Full remote work arrangements are role-specific and determined at the time of hire. Existing employees wishing to transition to full remote must submit a formal request to their HRBP. Approval is at the discretion of the business and requires VP-level sign-off. See Employee Handbook Section 9.4.

Question: What are the core office hours?
Answer: Core hours are 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM in your local time zone Monday through Friday. Outside of core hours employees have flexibility. Meetings should not be scheduled before 9:00 AM or after 6:00 PM in your local time zone. See Employee Handbook Section 8.1.

Question: What is the dress code?
Answer: OptiAgent follows a smart-casual dress code in all offices. On days when you have in-person customer or executive meetings formal business attire is expected. Safety-sensitive roles must follow any additional PPE requirements. See Employee Handbook Section 10.

Question: Where do I find the company holiday calendar?
Answer: The full holiday calendar is in the Holiday Calendar document (HR-HC-001) available on the HR Portal in SharePoint. You can also subscribe to the OptiAgent Holidays calendar in Microsoft Outlook.

Question: Is Good Friday a public holiday?
Answer: Good Friday is a public holiday in the UK and Germany. In the USA it is a company observance (half day). It is not a public holiday in India or Singapore for all employees (though some states may observe it). See Holiday Calendar (HR-HC-001) for your office location.

Question: Is Diwali a holiday?
Answer: Diwali (Naraka Chaturdashi / Lakshmi Puja) is a paid public holiday for all India offices (Bangalore
Related Document: Pune). Deepavali is also a paid holiday in Singapore. It is not a declared holiday for USA
Department: or Germany offices but employees may apply for annual leave. See Holiday Calendar (HR-HC-001).

Question: When is OptiAgent Founders Day?
Answer: OptiAgent Founders Day is observed on June 13 each year in all offices as a full paid company holiday celebrating the founding of OptiAgent Technologies. See Holiday Calendar (HR-HC-001).

Question: How many company holidays are there per year?
Answer: The total number of holidays varies by country: USA approx 11–12; India approx 16–18 (varies by state/office); UK approx 10–11; Germany approx 11–12; Singapore approx 12–13. See the Holiday Calendar (HR-HC-001) for the exact list for your office.

Question: What salary band is my role?
Answer: Salary bands are defined in the Salary Grades document (HR-SG-001) available on the HR Portal. You can also see your personal grade in your employment letter or in the Compensation section of Workday. Contact your HRBP if you have questions.

Question: What is my job level at OptiAgent?
Answer: OptiAgent uses a standardized job level framework: IC1 through IC7 for individual contributors and M1 through M5 for managers. Your level is listed in Workday under "My Profile > Job." See Salary Grades (HR-SG-001) for the full level descriptions.

Question: How are promotions decided?
Answer: Promotions are decided through the bi-annual talent review cycle (H1 and H2). Your manager nominates you; calibration is done at the Director level and above. Promotion requires meeting the performance rating threshold for your target level. See Salary Grades (HR-SG-001) Promotion Matrix (Sheet 3) and Employee Handbook Section 14.

Question: What performance rating is required for promotion?
Answer: Generally, a rating of "Exceeds Expectations" or above (top 2 out of 5 ratings) for at least one cycle and "Meets Expectations" in the current cycle is required. Specific requirements vary by level. See Salary Grades (HR-SG-001) Promotion Matrix.

Question: What bonuses am I eligible for?
Answer: Annual performance bonuses are paid in March for the prior fiscal year. Bonus percentages are defined by grade and country in Salary Grades (HR-SG-001) Sheet 4. Entry-level (IC1–IC2) bonuses are 5–8%; senior levels (IC5+) range from 15–30%. Executive bonuses are separate.

Question: Am I eligible for stock options?
Answer: Stock option eligibility begins at IC4 for individual contributors and M2 for managers. Options vest over 4 years with a 1-year cliff. See Salary Grades (HR-SG-001) Sheet 4 for the full vesting schedule. New option grants are reviewed annually.

Question: What is my allowance for mobile phone expenses?
Answer: Mobile allowance is defined by grade: IC1–IC3 receive USD 30/month; IC4–IC6 receive USD 50/month; M1–M3 receive USD 60/month; M4+ receive USD 80/month. Country-equivalent amounts are provided. See Salary Grades (HR-SG-001) Sheet 5 (Allowance Policy).

Question: What is the internet allowance for remote employees?
Answer: Remote employees (designated full remote in their offer letter) receive an internet allowance of USD 60/month (or country equivalent). This is reimbursed monthly via payroll. Submit the claim in Workday under Expense > Internet Allowance. See Salary Grades (HR-SG-001) Sheet 5.

Question: How do I get reimbursed for business expenses?
Answer: Submit expense claims in Workday within 30 days of incurring the expense. Attach receipts (PDF or image). Claims must be approved by your manager. See Employee Handbook Section 12 for expense limits by category.

Question: What is the policy on meal expenses?
Answer: Meals during business travel: up to USD 75/day per diem (or country equivalent). Client meals: up to USD 100 per person with manager pre-approval and a documented business purpose. Meals during internal meetings are not reimbursable unless the meeting lasts over 4 hours or runs through a mealtime. See Employee Handbook Section 12.3.

Question: What is the hotel expense limit for business travel?
Answer: Hotel limits by city tier: Tier 1 cities (New York
Keywords: Singapore): USD 300/night. Tier 2 cities: USD 200/night. India offices: INR 10000/night. Book through the Egencia corporate travel portal to automatically apply limits. See Employee Handbook Section 12.4.

Question: Do I need pre-approval for international travel?
Answer: Yes. All international business travel requires VP-level pre-approval in Workday before booking. Flights must be booked through Egencia (the company travel portal). Economy class for flights under 6 hours; business class for 6+ hours with Director+ approval. See Employee Handbook Section 12.5.

Question: What is the process for onboarding as a new employee?
Answer: The onboarding process starts before your first day with offer acceptance and background check. On Day 1 you will receive your laptop and access credentials. Orientation covers HR policies
Related Document: and security training. Your manager will set up a 30/60/90-day plan. See the full Onboarding Process (HR-OP-001).

Question: When will I receive my laptop?
Answer: Your laptop will be ready on your first day at the office (or shipped to your home address if you are a remote hire). You must log an equipment request through IT at least 5 business days before your start date. See Onboarding Process (HR-OP-001) Section 2.

Question: How do I set up my company email?
Answer: Your company email account (@optiagent.com) will be created by IT before your start date. You will receive a temporary password via SMS on your personal number provided during onboarding. Log in at login.optiagent.com (Okta) and reset your password on first login. See Onboarding Process (HR-OP-001) Section 3.

Question: What IT equipment am I entitled to?
Answer: Standard equipment: 14-inch laptop (Windows or Mac based on role and manager request); monitor (for office roles); headset; keyboard and mouse. Engineers may request a second monitor. Hardware beyond the standard kit requires manager and IT approval. See Onboarding Process (HR-OP-001) Section 2.2.

Question: What is the probation period?
Answer: The standard probation period is 3 months (90 days) for all new employees. During probation your performance is reviewed informally by your manager at 30 and 60 days. Formal confirmation occurs at the end of the 90-day period. See Onboarding Process (HR-OP-001) Section 10.

Question: Can my probation period be extended?
Answer: Yes. If performance concerns exist, probation may be extended by up to 3 additional months with written notice from your manager and HRBP sign-off. Extension must be communicated before the end of the original probation period. See Onboarding Process (HR-OP-001) Section 10.3.

Question: What happens if I fail probation?
Answer: If performance during probation is not satisfactory you may be released at the end of the probation period with notice per your country's legal requirements. The decision requires HRBP and legal review. See Employee Handbook Section 20 (Termination).

Question: What is the notice period for resignation?
Answer: Notice periods by level: IC1–IC3: 30 days; IC4–IC5: 60 days; IC6–IC7 and all managers: 90 days. Country-specific legal minimums apply and take precedence if greater. Your exact notice period is in your employment contract. See Employee Handbook Section 20.2.

Question: How do I resign from OptiAgent?
Answer: Submit a written resignation to your manager and copy hr.global@optiagent.com. Your resignation must be in writing (email is acceptable). You will be contacted by HR within 2 business days to initiate the exit process. See Employee Handbook Section 20.3.

Question: What is included in the exit process?
Answer: The exit process includes: completing a resignation form in Workday; returning all company equipment; revoking system access on your last day; completing an exit interview with HR; receiving a full and final settlement of salary, leave encashment, and benefits. See Employee Handbook Section 20.4.

Question: How do I access my payslips?
Answer: Payslips are available in Workday under Pay > Payslips. They are generated on the last working day of each month (USA/UK/SG) or the 1st working day of the following month (India/Germany). Historical payslips are available for 3 years.

Question: Who do I contact for payroll queries?
Answer: For payroll discrepancies contact the Payroll team at payroll@optiagent.com. For urgent issues in the first 3 days of the month use the payroll helpline listed in the Employee Handbook Section 5 (Internal Contacts).

Question: What is the payroll cycle?
Answer: USA: Semi-monthly (1st and 15th). UK: Monthly (last business day). India: Monthly (last business day). Germany: Monthly (last business day). Singapore: Monthly (last business day). See Employee Handbook Section 11.2.

Question: How do I update my bank account for payroll?
Answer: Log in to Workday > Pay > Payment Elections. Update your bank account details. Changes take effect from the next payroll cycle if submitted at least 5 business days before the pay date.

Question: How do I enroll in health insurance benefits?
Answer: Health insurance enrollment is completed during onboarding in Workday > Benefits > Benefit Elections. You have 30 days from your start date to enroll. Outside of this window you may only change elections during the annual Open Enrollment period (October–November). See Onboarding Process (HR-OP-001) Section 6.

Question: What health insurance plans are available?
Answer: Plans vary by country. USA: Medical/Dental/Vision via Aetna (3 plan tiers). UK: Private medical insurance via BUPA. India: Group health insurance via Star Health covering employee + spouse + 2 children. Germany: Company contributes to the statutory health insurance (GKV). Singapore: Group hospitalization via Great Eastern. See Employee Handbook Section 6 for details.

Question: Is there a life insurance benefit?
Answer: Yes. All employees receive a group term life insurance equivalent to 3x annual base salary at no cost to the employee. Additional coverage can be purchased during Open Enrollment. USA employees also have Short-Term and Long-Term Disability coverage. See Employee Handbook Section 6.4.

Question: What is the Employee Assistance Program (EAP)?
Answer: The EAP provides free and confidential counseling
Keywords: and legal consultations. Available 24/7 at 1-800-OPT-HELP (USA) or via the EAP portal (eap.optiagent.com). See Employee Handbook Section 6.7.

Question: How do I enroll in the 401(k) plan (USA)?
Answer: USA employees may enroll in the OptiAgent 401(k) plan via Fidelity NetBenefits within 30 days of hire. OptiAgent matches 100% of employee contributions up to 4% of base salary. See Employee Handbook Section 6.3 (USA Benefits).

Question: What is the pension arrangement in the UK?
Answer: UK employees are auto-enrolled into the OptiAgent UK Pension Scheme (via Aviva) at a 5% employee contribution and 4% employer contribution. You may opt out but will be re-enrolled annually per UK law. See Employee Handbook Section 6.3 (UK Benefits).

Question: What is the PF/EPF arrangement in India?
Answer: India employees are enrolled in the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF) mandatorily. Contribution: 12% of basic salary from the employee; 12% from the employer (split between EPF and EPS). Employees may also opt for the Voluntary Provident Fund (VPF). See Employee Handbook Section 6.3 (India Benefits).

Question: How do I submit an IT helpdesk request?
Answer: Submit a ticket via the IT Helpdesk portal (it.optiagent.com/helpdesk) or email it.help@optiagent.com. For urgent issues you may also call the helpdesk on the number listed in Employee Handbook Section 5 (Internal Contacts). Response SLA: P1 = 1 hour; P2 = 4 hours; P3 = 1 business day.

Question: How do I request a software license?
Answer: Submit a software license request via ServiceNow (it.optiagent.com/servicenow). Requests must include a business justification. Standard licenses are provisioned within 2 business days. Non-standard software must be approved by IT Security before purchase. See Company Policy Section 2.3.

Question: What is the company's data classification policy?
Answer: Data is classified into four tiers: Restricted
Keywords: and Public. See Company Policy (OAT-CP-001) Section 8 for full definitions and handling requirements for each tier. All documents must be labeled using Microsoft Purview.

Question: Can I use ChatGPT or Claude for work?
Answer: Personal consumer versions of AI tools (ChatGPT Personal
Related Document: Gemini consumer) are not approved for use with company data. Approved tools include OptiAgent Enterprise Platform
Department: and GitHub Copilot (engineering only). See Company Policy Section 12.

Question: Can I install software on my company laptop?
Answer: Only IT-approved software may be installed on company laptops. Submit a software request via ServiceNow. Installing unauthorized software including browser extensions without IT approval is a policy violation under Company Policy Section 2.3.

Question: What is the password requirement?
Answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters and include uppercase
Keywords: and special characters. MFA is mandatory for all accounts. Use the company-licensed 1Password manager. See Company Policy Section 4.

Question: What MFA methods are approved?
Answer: Approved MFA: YubiKey hardware token (required for production access)
Keywords: or Authenticator push notification. SMS OTP is only permitted as a fallback recovery method. See Company Policy Section 4.2.

Question: What do I do if I lose my work laptop?
Answer: Report immediately to IT Helpdesk (it.help@optiagent.com) and IT Security (security@optiagent.com). Do not attempt to locate or retrieve it yourself. IT will trigger a remote wipe. File a police report if stolen. See Company Policy Section 9.1.

Question: What do I do if I receive a phishing email?
Answer: Do not click any links or open attachments. Report the email using the Phish Alert Button (PAB) in Outlook or forward to security@optiagent.com. Do not delete the email before reporting. See Company Policy Section 9.1.

Question: How do I report a data breach?
Answer: Report any suspected data breach immediately to security@optiagent.com and your manager. Do not attempt to investigate yourself. The SOC team will respond within 15 minutes for critical incidents. See Company Policy Section 9.

Question: What is the performance review cycle?
Answer: Performance reviews occur twice per year: H1 review in July and H2 (annual) review in January. Ratings use a 5-point scale. See Employee Handbook Section 13 for the full performance management process.

Question: What are the performance rating levels?
Answer: 1 = Needs Improvement, 2 = Developing, 3 = Meets Expectations, 4 = Exceeds Expectations, 5 = Outstanding. Most employees receive a 3. Ratings of 4 and 5 require calibration justification. See Employee Handbook Section 13.2.

Question: Can I appeal my performance rating?
Answer: Yes. You may raise concerns about your rating with your HRBP within 10 business days of receiving your review. The HRBP will facilitate a discussion with your manager and their manager. See Employee Handbook Section 13.5.

Question: What learning and development resources are available?
Answer: All employees have access to LinkedIn Learning
Related Document: and the internal OptiAgent L&D Portal. A learning budget of USD 1500/year (or country equivalent) is available for external courses and certifications. See Employee Handbook Section 15.

Question: How do I access LinkedIn Learning?
Answer: Log in using your OptiAgent SSO credentials at learning.linkedin.com/optiagent. You do not need a separate account. Access is available to all employees. See Employee Handbook Section 15.2.

Question: What is the annual learning budget?
Answer: USD 1500 per employee per fiscal year (April 1 to March 31). Country-equivalent amounts: INR 80000 (India); GBP 1200 (UK); EUR 1400 (Germany); SGD 2000 (Singapore). Approvals required in Workday. See Employee Handbook Section 15.3.

Question: How do I get approval for an external training course?
Answer: Submit a Learning Request in Workday with the course details
Related Document: and business justification at least 2 weeks before the start date. Your manager approves requests up to USD 500. USD 501–1500 requires HRBP co-approval.

Question: Is there a mentoring program?
Answer: Yes. The OptiAgent MentorConnect program pairs employees with senior mentors for a 6-month engagement. Applications open in February and August each year via the L&D Portal. See Employee Handbook Section 15.5.

Question: What is the code of conduct?
Answer: The Code of Conduct outlines the ethical standards all employees must uphold including integrity
Keywords: and protection of company assets. See Employee Handbook Section 2. All employees must complete the annual Code of Conduct training in the L&D Portal.

Question: What is the whistleblower policy?
Answer: OptiAgent has a formal Speak Up policy. Employees can report concerns about ethics violations
Related Document: or policy breaches anonymously via the Ethics Hotline (1-800-OPT-ETHX) or at ethics.optiagent.com. No retaliation is permitted. See Employee Handbook Section 17.

Question: How do I report harassment or discrimination?
Answer: Report to your HRBP, directly to hr.global@optiagent.com, or via the Ethics Hotline anonymously. All reports are treated confidentially. See Employee Handbook Section 3 (Anti-Harassment Policy) for the full investigation process.

Question: What is the conflict of interest policy?
Answer: Employees must disclose any personal financial interest
Related Document: or personal relationship that could conflict with their duties at OptiAgent. Disclosure is made via the Conflict of Interest form in Workday. See Employee Handbook Section 16.

Question: Can I have a second job while working at OptiAgent?
Answer: Secondary employment must be disclosed and must not conflict with OptiAgent's business interests
Related Document: or involve competitors or customers. Submit a disclosure form via Workday. Final approval requires HRBP and manager sign-off. See Employee Handbook Section 16.2.

Question: What is the anti-bribery policy?
Answer: OptiAgent prohibits offering
Keywords: or accepting bribes or facilitation payments in any form in compliance with the US FCPA and UK Bribery Act. Training is mandatory annually. See Employee Handbook Section 2.5.

Question: Can I accept gifts from vendors or customers?
Answer: Gifts with a value under USD 50 (or local equivalent) may be accepted. Gifts above this threshold must be disclosed via the Gift & Hospitality Register in Workday. Cash gifts are never permitted regardless of value. See Employee Handbook Section 16.3.

Question: How do I access the HR portal?
Answer: The HR Portal is accessible via the Okta dashboard (login.optiagent.com) under the Workday tile. All HR documents
Related Document: and self-service functions are available there. You can also access SharePoint for HR policy documents.

Question: What is Workday used for?
Answer: Workday is OptiAgent's HRIS (Human Resources Information System). It is used for: leave requests
column9: and organizational charts. Access via login.optiagent.com.

Question: How do I update my personal information (address
Answer: phone number)?
Category: Log in to Workday > My Profile > Personal Information. You can update your address, emergency contacts, and phone number there. For legal name changes, contact hr.global@optiagent.com and provide official documentation.

Question: How do I change my tax withholding information (USA)?
Answer: Log in to Workday > Pay > Withholding Elections to update your W-4 information. Changes take effect from the next payroll cycle if submitted at least 3 business days before the pay date. Contact payroll@optiagent.com for assistance.

Question: Who is my HR Business Partner (HRBP)?
Answer: You can find your assigned HRBP in Workday under My Profile > HR Contacts. HRBP assignments are by department and country. For general inquiries contact hr.global@optiagent.com.

Question: How do I request a reference letter?
Answer: Contact hr.global@optiagent.com to request an employment verification or reference letter. Standard employment verification letters are processed within 3 business days. Detailed reference letters require manager input and may take up to 5 business days.

Question: What are the working hours in India?
Answer: Standard working hours in India are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST Monday to Friday with a 1-hour lunch break. Total working hours per week: 45 hours. Overtime is governed by the applicable state Shops and Establishments Act. See Employee Handbook Section 8.2.

Question: What are the working hours in Germany?
Answer: Germany: Standard hours are 8 hours per day / 40 hours per week per the Arbeitszeitgesetz (Working Hours Act). Overtime requires manager approval and must be compensated through comp off or pay. Rest period between shifts: minimum 11 hours. See Employee Handbook Section 8.4.

Question: What is the GDPR policy at OptiAgent?
Answer: OptiAgent acts as a Data Controller for employee data and a Data Processor for customer data under GDPR. Employee data processing activities and your rights as a data subject are detailed in Company Policy Section 15. Submit data subject requests to privacy@optiagent.com.

Question: How do I submit a data subject access request?
Answer: Submit your request to privacy@optiagent.com. Include your full name
Related Document: and specify the data you wish to access. OptiAgent will respond within 30 calendar days. See Company Policy Section 15.3.

Question: What is OptiAgent's background check process?
Answer: All new hires undergo background verification covering: identity check
Department: and credit check (finance and senior roles only). See Onboarding Process (HR-OP-001) Section 1.3.

Question: How long does the background check take?
Answer: Background checks typically take 5–10 business days. Your start date may be contingent on successful completion. Contact talent.ops@optiagent.com if there are delays or concerns with your check.

Question: What happens on Day 1 of onboarding?
Answer: Day 1 includes: equipment collection or delivery
Difficulty: and introduction to your team. See Onboarding Process (HR-OP-001) Section 4.

Question: What is the 30-60-90 day plan?
Answer: The 30/60/90-day plan is a structured plan created by you and your manager to set expectations for your first three months. Day 30: understand the role and team. Day 60: start contributing to projects. Day 90: operate independently and deliver. See Onboarding Process (HR-OP-001) Section 9.

Question: What security training is required during onboarding?
Answer: New employees must complete three mandatory security training modules within the first 14 days: Security Awareness Basics
Related Document: and Data Privacy Essentials. These are in the L&D Portal. See Onboarding Process (HR-OP-001) Section 5.3.

Question: How do I access the VPN?
Answer: Install the GlobalProtect VPN client (available in the IT Software Catalog on ServiceNow). Connect using your Okta credentials with MFA. VPN is required for accessing internal systems from outside the office or via BYOD. See Company Policy Section 3 and IT Helpdesk guide.

Question: What is the acceptable use policy for personal devices?
Answer: Personal devices (BYOD) may only be used to access company email
Keywords: and Workday. All BYOD devices must be enrolled in Microsoft Intune. See Company Policy Section 5 for the full BYOD policy.

Question: Can I print confidential documents?
Answer: Yes
Category: but you must collect printed documents immediately and not leave them unattended. Confidential and Restricted documents must be stored in locked drawers after printing. Unattended sensitive documents in printers or meeting rooms are a policy violation. See Company Policy Section 11.2.

Question: What is the clean desk policy?
Answer: At end of day all classified and confidential documents must be stored securely. Your computer screen must be locked. No sensitive materials should be left visible. See Company Policy Section 11.2.

Question: What happens to my access on my last day?
Answer: IT will revoke all system access on your last working day (or upon notice in cases of immediate termination). Ensure all company data is returned and devices are handed over to IT. Your access badge will also be deactivated. See Employee Handbook Section 20.4.

Question: What is the referral bonus for referring a new hire?
Answer: OptiAgent offers a referral bonus of USD 2000 (or local equivalent) for successful referrals hired into IC3+ roles. The bonus is paid 90 days after the referred employee's start date subject to both parties being active employees. See Employee Handbook Section 5.6.

Question: How do I submit a referral for an open position?
Answer: Submit referrals via the Workday Recruiting module under Refer a Candidate. Include the candidate's CV and your relationship. You will receive updates on the status of your referral.

Question: What is the maternity leave top-up?
Answer: During maternity leave OptiAgent pays the difference between statutory pay and 100% of your base salary for the duration of company-paid maternity leave (16 weeks globally; see Leave Policy for country-specific extensions). Return-to-work support includes a graduated return option.

Question: Can I take leave without pay (LWP)?
Answer: LWP is available at manager and HRBP discretion for personal reasons when all paid leave has been exhausted. Maximum LWP: 90 days in a rolling 12 months. Benefits may be affected during LWP. Submit via Workday and email hr.global@optiagent.com.

Question: What is the sabbatical policy?
Answer: Employees at IC5+ and M2+ with 5+ years of service may apply for an unpaid sabbatical of 1–3 months. Applications require 3 months advance notice and VP approval. Benefits are not maintained during sabbatical. See Employee Handbook Section 9.6.

Question: Can I donate my leave to a colleague?
Answer: OptiAgent operates a Leave Sharing Program. You may donate up to 5 days of annual leave per year to a colleague facing a medical emergency via the Leave Sharing Request in Workday. See Leave Policy Section 12.

Question: What is the marriage leave entitlement?
Answer: Employees receive 3 days paid leave for their own wedding. This leave must be applied at least 2 weeks in advance (except in exceptional circumstances). Applicable once during employment at OptiAgent. See Leave Policy Section 8.

Question: What is the policy for jury duty or civic leave?
Answer: USA employees on jury duty receive full pay for up to 10 days. UK employees are entitled to time off for jury service; OptiAgent pays the difference between jury allowance and regular salary. India, Germany, Singapore: applicable civic obligations are handled case by case. See Leave Policy Section 9.

Question: How do I request time off for religious observance?
Answer: Apply for annual leave in Workday. If you need additional accommodation for religious observance beyond your annual leave entitlement discuss it with your HRBP. OptiAgent makes reasonable accommodations for religious holidays. See Employee Handbook Section 3.4.

Question: What is the policy on flexible working hours?
Answer: Employees may flex their start and end times by up to 2 hours around the core hours (10 AM – 3 PM) with manager agreement. Formal flexible working arrangements (part-time
Category: compressed week) must be agreed in writing. See Employee Handbook Section 8.3.

Question: Can I work part-time?
Answer: Part-time working arrangements are available at manager and HR discretion. They must be formalized via a contract amendment. Part-time employees receive pro-rated salary
Related Document: and benefits. Apply at least 4 weeks in advance via your HRBP.

Question: What is the policy on overtime for salaried employees?
Answer: Salaried employees (exempt in the USA) are not paid for overtime as a general rule. In Germany the Arbeitszeitgesetz applies and overtime must be compensated. Where local law requires overtime pay HR will ensure compliance. See Employee Handbook Section 8.5.

Question: What is the company's alcohol and drug policy?
Answer: OptiAgent maintains a drug and alcohol-free workplace. Employees must not be under the influence of alcohol or controlled substances during work hours or on company premises. Violations may result in immediate dismissal. See Employee Handbook Section 10.4.

Question: What is the smoking policy?
Answer: Smoking and vaping are prohibited inside all OptiAgent offices and within 10 metres of office entrances. Designated outdoor smoking areas are provided at some offices. See Employee Handbook Section 10.5.

Question: What is the social media policy?
Answer: Employees may use personal social media but must not share confidential company information
Related Document: or represent personal opinions as company positions. Tag posts involving company matters as personal views. See Employee Handbook Section 11.

Question: Can I talk to the press or media about OptiAgent?
Answer: No. All media inquiries must be directed to the Communications and PR team at comms@optiagent.com. Employees must not make statements to media
Related Document: or public forums on behalf of OptiAgent without prior approval. See Employee Handbook Section 11.3.

Question: What do I do in a fire emergency?
Answer: Proceed calmly to the nearest fire exit. Do not use lifts. Assemble at the designated fire assembly point for your building (posted on exit signs). Do not re-enter until told to do so by Facilities or emergency services. See Employee Handbook Section 18.

Question: Where can I find first aid in the office?
Answer: First aid kits are located at the reception desk and in the kitchen area on each floor. Lists of trained first aiders for each floor are posted on notice boards and available from the Facilities team. See Employee Handbook Section 18.2.

Question: What is the policy on workplace violence?
Answer: Threats or acts of violence including verbal threats
Related Document: or harassment of any kind will result in immediate termination and potential criminal charges. Report any concerns to Security or HR immediately. See Employee Handbook Section 3.3.

Question: How do I get a visitor access badge?
Answer: Contact the Facilities team at facilities@optiagent.com at least 24 hours in advance. The visitor must sign in at reception and will be issued a temporary badge. They must be escorted at all times in secure areas. See Company Policy Section 11.1.

Question: What is the process for internal job transfers?
Answer: Open positions are posted on the internal job board in Workday. Employees may apply after completing a minimum of 12 months in their current role. Notify your current manager before applying. See Employee Handbook Section 14.4.

Question: How do I request a salary review outside of the annual cycle?
Answer: Out-of-cycle salary adjustments require VP+ approval and must be justified by market data or significant scope change. Submit the request to your HRBP with supporting documentation. These are rare and not guaranteed. See Employee Handbook Section 12.1.

Question: What is the relocation assistance policy?
Answer: OptiAgent provides relocation assistance for new hires and internal transfers requiring a city or country change. Assistance includes a one-time payment (IC1–IC3: USD 3000; IC4+: USD 6000) and 3 months of temporary accommodation support for international moves. See Employee Handbook Section 12.6.

Question: What is the company's equal opportunity policy?
Answer: OptiAgent is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race
column8: or any other protected characteristic. See Employee Handbook Section 3.1 and our EEO statement at careers.optiagent.com.

Question: How do I request a disability accommodation?
Answer: Contact your HRBP or email hr.global@optiagent.com to initiate a reasonable accommodation request. HR will work with you and your manager in an interactive process to determine appropriate accommodations. All discussions are kept confidential. See Employee Handbook Section 3.5.

Question: What is the nursing/lactation room policy?
Answer: Dedicated nursing rooms are available in all major offices. Rooms are reservable via the room booking tool in Outlook. For remote employees nursing breaks are accommodated flexibly. Contact Facilities for room locations. See Employee Handbook Section 10.6.

Question: Can I bring my pet to the office?
Answer: Pets are permitted in the San Francisco office on designated Pet-Friendly Fridays (first Friday of each month) subject to the Pet Policy (no aggressive breeds
Related Document: pet must be leashed). Other offices do not currently permit pets. Contact Facilities for details.

Question: What is the policy on employee personal relationships at work?
Answer: Relationships between employees are permitted but must be disclosed to HR if there is a direct reporting relationship to avoid conflicts of interest. Intimate relationships between a manager and their direct report require one party to transfer to another team. See Employee Handbook Section 3.6.

Question: How is performance improvement handled?
Answer: If your performance is not meeting expectations your manager will initiate a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) in Workday. A PIP runs for 60–90 days with clear goals. Successful completion returns you to normal performance management. Unsuccessful completion may result in termination. See Employee Handbook Section 13.6.

Question: What is the severance policy?
Answer: Severance for involuntary termination (non-misconduct) is governed by local law minimums. OptiAgent provides a severance package of 1 week per completed year of service in the USA (minimum 2 weeks). Other countries follow local legal requirements. See Employee Handbook Section 20.5.

Question: How are layoffs handled?
Answer: In the event of a redundancy/layoff OptiAgent will follow applicable laws in each country including consultation requirements (UK
Category: Germany). Affected employees receive advance notice
Department: and outplacement support. See Employee Handbook Section 20.6.

Question: What is the difference between redundancy and termination for cause?
Answer: Redundancy (reduction in force) occurs when a role is eliminated for business reasons — no fault of the employee. Termination for cause involves a conduct or performance issue. Notice and severance terms differ significantly. See Employee Handbook Section 20.

Question: Who approves a PIP?
Answer: PIPs must be approved by the HRBP and the manager's manager before being issued. HR drafts the PIP template. The employee's signature acknowledges receipt (not necessarily agreement). See Employee Handbook Section 13.6.

Question: What is the OptiAgent mentorship program?
Answer: The MentorConnect program runs twice per year (February and August cohorts). It pairs employees seeking career development with senior mentors from across the company. Duration: 6 months. Apply via the L&D Portal. See Employee Handbook Section 15.5.

Question: What engineering certifications does OptiAgent support?
Answer: OptiAgent supports certifications in cloud platforms (AWS
column10: and AI/ML. Costs are covered by the learning budget. Engineering-specific certifications may receive additional budget allocation — check with your HRBP. See Employee Handbook Section 15.4.

Question: What happens to unvested stock options when I resign?
Answer: Unvested stock options are forfeited upon resignation. Vested options must be exercised within 90 days of your last day or they will expire. See your individual stock option agreement and contact equity@optiagent.com for your balance.

Question: Can I expense my home office setup?
Answer: Remote employees (designated full remote) may expense up to USD 500 one-time for home office equipment (chair
Keywords: peripherals). Submit via Workday with receipts. See Employee Handbook Section 12.7.

Question: Is there a tuition reimbursement program?
Answer: Yes. OptiAgent reimburses tuition for job-related degree programs at accredited universities up to USD 5250 per calendar year (USA; tax-free limit). Employees must remain with OptiAgent for 12 months post-completion or repay the reimbursement on a sliding scale. See Employee Handbook Section 15.6.

Question: What is the company gym or wellness benefit?
Answer: All employees receive a monthly wellness allowance of USD 50/month (or local equivalent) for gym memberships
Related Document: or wellness activities. Reimbursed via Workday Expense. Some offices have on-site gyms. See Employee Handbook Section 6.8.

Question: Are there childcare benefits?
Answer: USA employees may participate in the Dependent Care FSA (DCFSA) to set aside up to USD 5000 pre-tax for childcare. Some offices have access to a childcare referral service via the EAP. See Employee Handbook Section 6.5.

Question: How do I claim the commuter benefit (USA)?
Answer: USA employees may participate in the CommuterBenefit program to set aside pre-tax dollars for transit and parking (up to IRS limits per month). Enroll or update elections in Workday > Benefits > Commuter Benefits.

Question: How do I get my ISO 27001 or SOC 2 certification details for a customer query?
Answer: Direct customer compliance questions to the Security team at security.compliance@optiagent.com. The SOC 2 Type II report is available under NDA to customers. ISO 27001 certificate can be shared with customers directly. See Company Policy Section 3.1.

Question: What should I do if a customer asks for a data processing agreement (DPA)?
Answer: Forward the request to legal.compliance@optiagent.com. The Legal team manages all DPA negotiations. Do not agree to DPA terms without Legal review. See Company Policy Section 15.

Question: What is the conflict of interest declaration process?
Answer: Fill in the Conflict of Interest Disclosure form in Workday annually (and ad-hoc when a new conflict arises). Your HRBP reviews disclosures. See Employee Handbook Section 16.

Question: Can I have equity or stock in a competitor company?
Answer: Owning publicly-traded stock in a competitor does not generally constitute a conflict of interest unless it is a material holding. Ownership of >1% of a competitor's shares or any private equity stake in a competitor must be disclosed. See Employee Handbook Section 16.1.

Question: What records do I need to retain from customer meetings?
Answer: Notes and agreed actions from customer meetings should be logged in Salesforce (CRM). Formal agreements and proposals must be filed in SharePoint. Personal notes and informal records should not be stored on personal devices. See Company Policy Section 14 and Employee Handbook Section 19.

Question: What is the Records Retention schedule?
Answer: Records retention periods vary by type. Key examples: personnel files 7 years; financial records 7 years; customer contracts 7 years after expiry; security logs 3 years; board minutes permanent. See Company Policy Section 14 for the full table.

Question: How do I handle a customer asking for our internal employee data?
Answer: Under no circumstances should employee personal data be shared with customers. Refer all such requests to the Privacy team (privacy@optiagent.com). This would constitute a GDPR breach if the data involves EU/UK individuals. See Company Policy Section 15.

Question: What is the policy for international data transfers?
Answer: International transfers of personal data from the EU/UK to countries outside the EEA require adequate safeguards (Standard Contractual Clauses
Related Document: or Binding Corporate Rules). Contact the Privacy team before transferring data internationally. See Company Policy Section 15.

Question: What is the process for issuing a legal hold?
Answer: Legal holds are issued by the Legal team when litigation or investigation is anticipated. Employees in scope receive a formal Legal Hold Notice. You must preserve all documents
Related Document: and data related to the hold. Do not delete anything. See Company Policy Section 6.3.

Question: How is customer PII handled?
Answer: Customer PII must be handled in accordance with the Restricted data classification controls: encrypted at rest and in transit
Category: access on a need-to-know basis only
Related Document: no transfer to personal devices. See Company Policy Section 8.1.

Question: Can I work in a coffee shop or public place?
Answer: Yes but you must use the company VPN at all times on unsecured Wi-Fi networks. Do not work on classified or confidential documents in public places where screens may be visible. Lock your screen when stepping away. See Employee Handbook Section 9.5.

Question: What travel insurance does OptiAgent provide for business travel?
Answer: All employees travelling on company business are covered by the OptiAgent Business Travel Insurance policy (via Allianz). Coverage includes medical emergencies
Keywords: and evacuation. Register your trip in Egencia to activate coverage. See Employee Handbook Section 12.8.

Question: Do I need a work visa to travel to another country for meetings?
Answer: For short-term business visits (under 30 days) a business visa or visa-waiver may be applicable depending on your nationality and destination. Always check with the Legal/Mobility team (mobility@optiagent.com) before booking international travel. OptiAgent will not be liable for immigration violations due to employee failure to obtain proper authorizations.

Question: What is the compassionate leave policy?
Answer: Compassionate leave covers bereavement. See the Bereavement Leave section of the Leave Policy (HR-LP-001) Section 6. In exceptional circumstances additional unpaid leave may be granted at manager and HRBP discretion.

Question: What is the overtime policy in India?
Answer: India employees are governed by the applicable state Shops and Establishments Act. Overtime beyond 9 hours per day or 48 hours per week must be compensated at twice the ordinary rate. IT/ITES employees in Karnataka are subject to the Karnataka Shops and Establishments Act. See Employee Handbook Section 8.2.

Question: What is the notice period in India?
Answer: India: IC1–IC3: 30 days; IC4+: 60 days; M2+: 90 days. The contract governs. Garden leave may be applied at company discretion. See Employee Handbook Section 20.2 and your employment contract.

Question: What is the notice period in Germany?
Answer: Germany: Statutory minimum notice per § 622 BGB scales from 4 weeks (0–2 years) to 7 months (20+ years). OptiAgent generally aligns with these statutory minimums unless the contract specifies longer notice for senior roles. See Employee Handbook Section 20.2.

Question: What are the data privacy rights of employees in Germany?
Answer: Germany has strong employee data protection rights under the BDSG (Bundesdatenschutzgesetz) and GDPR. Employees have the right to access
Related Document: and delete personal data. Works council agreements (Betriebsvereinbarungen) may govern specific processing activities like IT monitoring. See Company Policy Section 2.4 and 15.

Question: Is there a works council at OptiAgent Germany?
Answer: OptiAgent Germany does have a Betriebsrat (Works Council). Employees may contact the Works Council on matters of workplace conditions
Related Document: and collective policies. The Works Council must be consulted on certain HR matters per the BetrVG (Works Constitution Act).

Question: What is the tax treatment of RSUs?
Answer: RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) are taxed as ordinary income at the time of vesting in most countries. Tax treatment varies: USA (W-2 income)
Keywords: Germany (Lohnsteuer). Contact equity@optiagent.com for your specific situation.

Question: How are annual salary increases determined?
Answer: Annual salary increases (merit increases) are determined during the H2 performance cycle (January) based on your performance rating
Related Document: and market data. Increases range from 0% (Needs Improvement) to 12%+ (Outstanding). See Salary Grades (HR-SG-001) Sheet 3.

Question: What is the meal reimbursement for late-night work?
Answer: Employees required to work past 9:00 PM due to a business need may claim a meal reimbursement of up to USD 25 (or local equivalent) per occurrence. Requires manager approval and a receipt. Submit via Workday Expense. See Employee Handbook Section 12.3.

Question: Is there a policy on mobile phone use while driving for business?
Answer: Use of mobile phones while driving company vehicles or during business trips is prohibited unless a hands-free system is used. This applies even where local law may not prohibit it. Violation is a disciplinary matter. See Employee Handbook Section 18.4.

Question: What is the policy on workplace surveillance / monitoring?
Answer: OptiAgent monitors network traffic and device activity for security purposes. Physical CCTV is installed in common areas. Monitoring is conducted lawfully and disclosed in this document and your employment contract. See Company Policy Section 2.4 and 15.2.

Question: Can I access work systems from a personal cloud storage account?
Answer: No. Company data must not be stored in personal cloud storage (personal Google Drive
Difficulty: or designated project repositories. See Company Policy Section 8.

Question: What happens if I breach the AI usage policy?
Answer: Breaches of the AI Usage Policy are treated as a security or data policy violation and subject to disciplinary action up to and including termination. Accidental disclosure of Restricted data to an AI tool requires immediate incident reporting. See Company Policy Section 12 and 16.2.

Question: What is the company policy on use of open-source software?
Answer: Open-source software usage in company products must be approved by the Engineering and Legal teams. License compatibility review is required (GPL
Related Document: etc. may impose open-sourcing obligations). Use of approved open-source libraries in internal tools is permitted. See Employee Handbook Section 19.3.

Question: What is the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) security policy?
Answer: All code must pass static analysis (SAST) and dependency vulnerability scanning (SCA) before merge. Production deployments require peer review and approval. Security testing is required for customer-facing features. See Company Policy Section 3 and engineering runbooks.

Question: How do I report a workplace safety hazard?
Answer: Report immediately to your Facilities contact or via the Safety Reporting form on the HR Portal. For life-threatening hazards evacuate the area and call emergency services first. See Employee Handbook Section 18.1.

Question: What PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) is provided?
Answer: PPE is provided for roles that require it (data center technicians
Related Document: etc.). Contact the Facilities team for your specific requirements. See Employee Handbook Section 18.3.

Question: How do I update my emergency contact information?
Answer: Log in to Workday > My Profile > Emergency Contacts. You can add or update contacts there. It is recommended to keep this information current at all times. See Onboarding Process (HR-OP-001) Section 4.5.

Question: Who approves my expense reports?
Answer: Your direct manager approves expense reports in Workday. For amounts over USD 1000 your manager's manager must also approve. Finance final processing occurs after approvals are complete. See Employee Handbook Section 12.2.

Question: What is the policy on accepting hospitality from vendors?
Answer: Hospitality (meals
Related Document: gifts) from vendors must be disclosed via the Gift & Hospitality Register if the estimated value exceeds USD 50. Invitations to vendor events (conferences
Keywords: sporting events) valued above USD 150 require HRBP and manager approval. See Employee Handbook Section 16.3.

Question: Can I publish a research paper or article about work I do at OptiAgent?
Answer: Academic publications and public articles describing your work must be reviewed and approved by Legal and your department head before submission. Do not include proprietary algorithms
Related Document: or trade secrets. Allow 3 weeks for review. See Employee Handbook Section 16.5.

Question: What is the policy on side projects using OptiAgent IP?
Answer: Any project developed using OptiAgent time
Related Document: or confidential knowledge is considered company property per the PIIA agreement. Personal side projects developed entirely on personal time and resources with no relation to OptiAgent's business are permitted with disclosure to HR.

Question: What is the grievance procedure?
Answer: If you have a workplace grievance raise it informally with your manager first. If unresolved escalate to your HRBP. For formal grievances submit a written complaint to hr.global@optiagent.com. A formal investigation will be conducted within 10 business days. See Employee Handbook Section 3.7.

Question: How is the disciplinary process structured?
Answer: The disciplinary process follows: verbal warning (documented), written warning, final written warning, termination. The severity of the step depends on the nature of the infraction. Gross misconduct may result in immediate dismissal without prior warnings. See Employee Handbook Section 20.1.

Question: What constitutes gross misconduct?
Answer: Gross misconduct examples: theft
column8: deliberate violation of IT security policy. Gross misconduct may result in immediate termination without notice. See Employee Handbook Section 20.1.

Question: Is there a non-compete clause in my contract?
Answer: Some roles include a non-compete clause preventing you from joining a direct competitor for 6–12 months after leaving OptiAgent. Review your individual employment contract or contact legal.compliance@optiagent.com for clarification. Enforceability varies by jurisdiction.

Question: What is the non-solicitation clause?
Answer: Employees agree not to solicit OptiAgent employees or customers to join or do business with a competitor for 12 months after leaving OptiAgent. See your employment contract and Employee Handbook Section 20.7.

Question: Can I work for OptiAgent as a contractor or consultant after I resign?
Answer: Former employees may be engaged as contractors after a 6-month cooling-off period and with VP and Legal approval. They must not work on projects they had direct involvement in. Contact legal.compliance@optiagent.com.

Question: What is the expense limit for client entertainment?
Answer: Client entertainment requires manager pre-approval and a documented business purpose. Limit: USD 100 per person per meal. Gifts to clients: USD 75 limit. Any entertainment involving alcohol requires Director+ approval and must follow anti-bribery rules. See Employee Handbook Section 12.3.

Question: How do I get a corporate credit card?
Answer: Corporate credit cards are issued to IC5+ employees and all managers (M1+) and to employees who travel frequently. Apply via Finance (finance.ap@optiagent.com). Cards are for business use only and must be reconciled monthly in Workday. See Employee Handbook Section 12.9.

Question: What is the process for a probation review?
Answer: Your manager will schedule informal check-ins at Day 30 and Day 60. At Day 90 a formal probation review is conducted. If performance is satisfactory a confirmation letter is issued via Workday. See Onboarding Process (HR-OP-001) Section 10.

Question: Who do I contact if Workday is not working?
Answer: Contact the IT Helpdesk at it.help@optiagent.com or via ServiceNow. Workday outages are tracked on the IT Status page (status.optiagent.com). See Employee Handbook Section 5 (Internal Contacts).

Question: What is the IT Asset Return process when I leave?
Answer: You must return all company equipment (laptop
Difficulty: etc.) to your local IT team on or before your last day. IT will issue a receipt. Failure to return equipment may result in deduction from final settlement. See Employee Handbook Section 20.4.

Question: What is the policy for using personal GitHub accounts for company code?
Answer: Company code must reside in the OptiAgent GitHub organization (github.com/optiagent). Using personal GitHub accounts for company code is prohibited. Contact DevSecOps if you need access to a specific repository. See Company Policy Section 2.3.

Question: Can I use USB drives on my company laptop?
Answer: USB storage devices are disabled by endpoint policy on company laptops. If you require a USB drive for a legitimate business reason submit a request to IT Security for a company-issued encrypted USB. See Company Policy Section 2.3.

Question: What is the company's stance on AI-generated code in production?
Answer: AI-generated code is permitted with mandatory human code review and security scanning per the engineering SDLC process. The reviewing engineer is accountable for AI-generated code. No AI-generated code may be deployed to production without a completed code review. See Company Policy Section 12.4.

Question: What should I do if I discover a security vulnerability in our product?
Answer: Report it immediately to security@optiagent.com and your manager. Use the Security Incident form in ServiceNow. Do not attempt to exploit or document the vulnerability beyond what is needed to report it. See Company Policy Section 9.

Question: Is there a bug bounty program?
Answer: OptiAgent operates an external bug bounty program via HackerOne. Internal employees are not eligible to participate in the bug bounty program. Internal security disclosures should be made via the Security Incident process. See Company Policy Section 9.

Question: What learning content is available for AI and machine learning?
Answer: The L&D Portal includes curated paths for: ML Fundamentals (Coursera)
Keywords: and OptiAgent's internal AI Platform training. External AI/ML courses also qualify for the learning budget. See Employee Handbook Section 15.

Question: How do I access the internal Confluence knowledge base?
Answer: Confluence is accessible via the Okta dashboard (login.optiagent.com). All employees have read access; write access requires a request via ServiceNow. Engineering teams maintain their own Confluence spaces. See IT Helpdesk for access issues.

Question: What is the company's policy on personal use of company software licenses?
Answer: Company software licenses (Adobe
Keywords: etc.) are for business use only. Personal use is not permitted. Some licenses (like LinkedIn Learning) are available 24/7 for both professional development and personal learning. See Company Policy Section 2.2.

Question: What is the policy on end-of-year carry-forward requests for Germany?
Answer: Germany employees must take their full annual leave entitlement within the calendar year. Under the Bundesurlaubsgesetz leave carried forward beyond March 31 of the following year is generally forfeited unless medical certification prevents taking leave. See Leave Policy Section 8.4.

Question: How do I apply for parental leave in Singapore?
Answer: Singapore parental leave is governed by the Child Development Co-Savings Act. Notify HR at least 3 months before expected delivery. Submit your leave request in Workday. Government-paid leave claims are processed via GPPL. See Leave Policy Section 7.7.

Question: What is the Creche / Childcare reimbursement for India employees?
Answer: India employees may claim a tax-exempt reimbursement of up to INR 1200/month for childcare expenses at a registered creche or daycare facility. Submit receipts via Workday > Expense > Childcare Reimbursement. See Employee Handbook Section 6.5.

Question: What is the gratuity policy in India?
Answer: India employees are entitled to gratuity under the Payment of Gratuity Act after 5 years of continuous service. Gratuity is calculated as: 15 days salary for each completed year of service. OptiAgent administers gratuity via a Group Gratuity Trust. See Employee Handbook Section 6.3 (India).

Question: What is the LTA benefit in India?
Answer: Leave Travel Allowance (LTA) is a tax-exempt component of the CTC for India employees. LTA can be claimed twice in a 4-year block for domestic travel within India. Submit travel bills via Workday during the LTA claim window (November–December). See Employee Handbook Section 6.9.

Question: What is the HRA policy in India?
Answer: House Rent Allowance (HRA) is a component of the India CTC. Tax exemption on HRA is calculated per Income Tax Act rules. To claim HRA exemption submit rent receipts to payroll@optiagent.com by January 15 each year. See Employee Handbook Section 11.4 (India Tax).

Question: What is the cycle-to-work scheme (UK)?
Answer: UK employees can participate in the Cycle to Work scheme to purchase a bike and safety equipment tax-efficiently. Apply via the Benefits Portal in Workday during Open Enrollment. See Employee Handbook Section 6.3 (UK).

Question: What private medical insurance does OptiAgent offer in the UK?
Answer: UK employees are covered by BUPA private medical insurance with dental and optical add-ons available. The policy covers the employee; spouse/partner and dependants can be added at a subsidised premium. See Employee Handbook Section 6.3 (UK).

Question: What is the Kurzarbeit policy in Germany?
Answer: OptiAgent may apply for Kurzarbeit (short-time working scheme) in the event of a significant business downturn with works council agreement. This is a government-supported scheme; employees receive reduced hours and a top-up from the Bundesagentur für Arbeit. See Employee Handbook Section 8.6.

Question: What is the CPF contribution for Singapore employees?
Answer: Singapore employees and OptiAgent contribute to the Central Provident Fund (CPF). Employee contribution: 20% of ordinary wages (for employees below 55). Employer contribution: 17%. CPF contributions are deducted from gross salary each month. See Employee Handbook Section 6.3 (Singapore).

Question: What is the Annual Wage Supplement (AWS) in Singapore?
Answer: OptiAgent Singapore pays a 13th month Annual Wage Supplement (AWS) equivalent to one month's base salary paid in December each year. This applies to all permanent Singapore employees who have completed at least 3 months of service. See Employee Handbook Section 11.5.
